sentences.text: Exploring a research collaboration on CACNA1A-related disorders
We are writing to the CACNA1A Foundation, a parent-led organisation dedicated to finding a cure for CACNA1A genetic variants.
We understand the Rare Epilepsy Network lists the Foundation as a member, and DEE-P Connections links to it as a partner, though that is not a formal membership record.
Published work links CACNA1A-related disorders to both gain of function and loss of function, so the mechanism appears to vary and is not settled.
Your Contact Registry and the Citizen Health platform already include people with these disorders.
Two completed headache studies in familial hemiplegic migraine types 1 and 2 included CACNA1A, and a registry and a survey study of epilepsy-dyskinesia syndromes are recruiting.
A phase 3 pivotal study of N-acetyl-L-leucine for CACNA1A is also recruiting.
We would like to explore a jointly designed study on CACNA1A-related disorders, shaped with your community from the start: [study question], [design], [sites].
Any participation would follow informed consent and ethics approval, and we would share what we learn with your community.

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you be open to a conversation about whether this idea is useful to the families you serve?
If so, we would value your view on how your community, registry or natural history work could take part, with proper consent and ethics approval.
We are not asking for any personal information about patients or families.
Could we arrange a short call at a time that suits you, perhaps [proposed dates]?
With thanks and warm regards, [researcher name], [institution].
